purpose: Fast flow-direction routing, catchment masks, upstream area, and Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND) for flood inundation

from_array.check_ftype: false when converting from pysheds (254 pit cells may appear)
from_array.transform: affine transform matching the DEM raster

FlwdirRaster.hand.drain: boolean mask of stream/channel cells (e.g. accumulation >= threshold)
FlwdirRaster.hand.elevtn: 2D float32 conditioned DEM (same shape as flow dir)
FlwdirRaster.hand.output: HAND grid in metres — height above nearest drainage cell

upstream_area.units: m² when transform is in metres (EPSG:5070 or UTM)

gotchas: hand(drain, elevtn) requires TWO positional args — drain mask first, then elevation. Not hand(elev) alone.
pysheds flowdir int32 must be cast to uint8 before from_array; invalid/pit cells may be 254.
Stream mask `drain` must align with conditioned DEM used for HAND — use same pit-filled surface as TWI.
GMS/level-path HAND (multiple fluvial sources) is required at confluences; plain single-source HAND under-predicts junction flooding.
HAND assumes steady level-pool stage from channel; not valid for pluvial, coastal, or backwater-dominated floods.

common_patterns.stage_lookup:
stages = np.linspace(0, np.nanmax(hand), n_steps)
lookup = {float(s): int((hand <= s).sum()) for s in stages}
